title: Croatian Nut Stir Fry
description: A vegan twist on traditional Croatian stir fries, featuring toasted nuts and crispy vegetables.
instructions: Heat the Croatian nut oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced bell pepper and cook for 3-4 minutes, or until tender and crisp.
Add the sliced carrots and cook for an additional 4-5 minutes, or until tender.
Add the sliced onions and cook for 2-3 minutes, or until translucent.
Add the chopped walnuts and cook for 1-2 minutes, or until fragrant.
Season with Croatian black pepper to taste.
If desired, add the nutritional yeast and stir to combine.
Serve hot, garnished with additional chopped nuts if desired.
Enjoy your delicious Croatian Nut Stir Fry!
